abilities.name: YOU CALL IT YOURS, I CALL IT MINE
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown that target an enemy unit that is within 6" of an enemy unit that has an enhancement.

abilities.name: GRIZZLED BUCCANEERS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
This unit can immediately use a SHOOT ability as if it were your shooting phase but all of its attacks must target the target enemy unit.
For the rest of the phase, this unit’s Privateer Heavy Weapons have Shoot in Combat.

abilities.name: MEDIUM BOMB RACKS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have FLY and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: INCOMING!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: ASSAULT BOAT
abilities.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it is in combat or has used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn. Pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity that are wholly within 6" of it, that are not in combat and that have not charged this turn to be the targets. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll and must end the move within ½" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so:
Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within this unit’s combat range. The targets can be set up in combat.
This unit and the targets have charged, and the targets cannot use another Core ability this phase.
Pick up to 1 of the targets to have STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Heavy Sky Ordnance is 3.

abilities.name: TRANSPORT CAPACITY
abilities.effect: This unit can transport up to 2 friendly KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY units with a combined model count of up to 12 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: CAPTAIN OF THE AELSLING
abilities.declare: Pick an Arkanaut Frigate in this unit’s regiment to be the target. This unit can use this ability while in reserve, and the target can also be in reserve.
abilities.effect: The target has the AELSLING keyword. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s Boarding Weapons for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: SHE CAN HANDLE IT!

abilities.name: AUXILIARY SKYHOOK
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Subtract 1 from wound rolls made for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SUDDEN EMERGENCE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: If the Rabble-Rowza in this Regiment of Renown is in a super-secret tunnel, pick it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up all other friendly units that are in a super-secret tunnel within 3" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUPER-SECRET TUNNELS
abilities.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in a super-secret tunnel. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: SNEAKY DISTRACTION
abilities.declare: Pick the Gobbapalooza in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

abilities.name: BOING! BOING! BOING!
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit that passed across the target. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscrolls.name: Rabble-Rowza
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Moonclan Agitator.

abilities.name: SECRET TUNNELS
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.

abilities.name: EMERGE FROM THE DEPTHS

abilities.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: ’NEH NEH NA-NEH NEH! CAN’T CATCH ME!’
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly MONSTER or BEAST unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN ability in the same turn, but each time it uses a MOVE ability, it must end the move closer to this unit. abilities.name: GOBBAPALOOZA KNOW-WOTZ
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:

abilities.name: HALLUCINOGENIC FUNGUS BREWS
abilities.effect: In the first battle round, this unit has WARD (4+). In the second battle round, this unit has WARD (5+). In the third and subsequent battle rounds, this unit has WARD (6+).

abilities.name: BEAST

abilities.name: SQUIGS GONE WILD
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: ARCANE CHARGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a Place of Power you control to be the target.

abilities.name: EARTH-SHAKING STOMP
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy INFANTRY and CAVALRY units while they are in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: TITANIC STRIDE
abilities.effect: The unit in this Regiment of Renown can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the unit in this Regiment of Renown by RETREAT abilities.

warscrolls.name: Warstomper Mega-Gargant
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout.

abilities.name: DON’T STOMP THOSE, STOMP THEM!

abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly BIG or LITTLE unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that has not been set up this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can move 2D6". It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that it was in combat with at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: ALMIGHTIER STOMPIN’
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect:

abilities.name: TITANIC BOULDERCLUB

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Titanic Boulderclub is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilities.name: ON DA MOON’S TRAIL
abilities.effect: The melee weapons of units in this Regiment of Renown have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are contesting an objective you control.

abilities.name: WHIRLING DEATH
abilities.effect: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST.

abilities.name: RELEASE THE FANATICS!

abilities.name: HIDDEN LOONS

abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Fortcrusha Flail.

abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit that is not uprooted, then pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit within 3" of that terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+:
If the target is another BIG unit, excluding Gatebreaker Mega-Gargants, it is armed with a Hurled Boulder for the rest of the turn (see the weapon profile on this unit’s warscroll. Modifiers to this unit’s ranged weapons or shooting attacks do not apply to the target).

abilities.name: TO THE SHIPS!

abilities.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for the recipient’s combat attacks.

abilities.name: REBUILD ON THE MARCH

abilities.effect: Reset the Gothizzar Harvester’s bone-tithe points to 0. Then, set up a replacement of the target unit with half the number of models (rounding up) wholly within 9" of the Gothizzar Harvester and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SHIELDS OF THE LEGION
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability that targeted a visible OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit within this unit’s combat range
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks made as part of that Attack ability that target any friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units within this unit’s combat range.

abilities.name: BONE CAGE

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is full, pick a visible friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit. If the target has a Health characteristic of 1 return 3 slain models to it instead. Then, this unit is empty.

abilities.name: GRUESOME DEVOURERS

abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by a friendly MEATFIST unit’s combat attacks to be the target.

abilities.name: MEATY CHARGE

abilities.name: GLUTTONOUS CONQUERORS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Control characteristic of friendly MEATFIST units while they are in combat.

abilities.name: GREEDY CHOMPERS

abilities.effect: Each time an enemy HERO that is contesting an objective is slain by a combat attack made by a friendly HERO, add the Control characteristic of that slain HERO to the control score of that friendly HERO for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: SIEGE BREAKERS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO PETRIFEX ELITE unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target’s melee weapons have Anti-WATCHTOWER (+1 Rend) for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: BODYGUARD
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units that have not charged this turn and are wholly within 6" of your general.

abilities.name: EMERGENCY SHORING
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a Watchtower within 3" of a friendly INFANTRY unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Heal (D6) the target. That friendly INFANTRY unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: LETHISIAN FORTIFICATIONS
abilities.effect: Friendly units have WARD (6+) while they are wholly within 3" of a friendly Watchtower.

abilities.name: ESCAPE ROUTE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and is within 3" of the escape route battlefield edge to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield. It has escaped.

abilities.name: TOUGH AS STONE
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for shooting attacks made by enemy units that target friendly PETRIFEX ELITE units that are more than 12" from them.

abilities.name: FEARLESS DEFENDERS
abilities.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly units while they are within 3" of a secure fortification.

abilities.name: TIRELESS TREAD
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO PETRIFEX ELITE unit that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: FOR LETHIS!
abilities.effect: Make 3 rally rolls of D6 for each friendly Lethis unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of the unit using the 'Rally' command.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared the 'Rally' command

abilities.name: SOUND THE HORNS OF WAR
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army). Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Subtract 2 from charge rolls for friendly and enemy units for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: CONSTRUCTS OF WAR
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly HEROES that target an enemy HERO.

abilities.name: DESPERATE REINFORCEMENTS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: You can return D3 slain models to each friendly unit in combat.

abilities.name: UNSTOPPABLE FORCE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO PETRIFEX ELITE unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use a RUN ability and still use CHARGE abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: RALLY THE RESERVES
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly non-UNIQUE units that have been destroyed to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up replacement units more than 9" from all enemy units and either wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge in friendly territory or wholly within 3" of a secure fortification.

abilities.name: THE COLUMN MARCHES ONWARDS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly non-UNIQUE units that have been destroyed to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up replacement units more than 9" from all enemy units and either wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge in friendly territory or wholly within 3" of a seized fortification.

abilities.name: STORM THE FORTIFICATIONS
abilities.declare: Pick a secure fortification that you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that fortification is no longer secure and is seized for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: WARDS AGAINST UNDEATH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 15" of a secure fortification that has no enemy units within 3" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Both players roll 2D6. If the Lethis player’s roll is higher than the Petrifex Elite player’s roll, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the rolls.

abilities.name: OVERFLOWING LARDER
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Gain D6 raw ingredients. If this unit is a Feastmaster, gain D3+3 raw ingredients instead.

abilities.name: INDOMITABLE GUTS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to ward rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: PREPARE THE FEAST
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If there is no friendly Feastmaster on the battlefield, pick a friendly GOLLOP HERO to be the Feastmaster for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: GORE-OFFAL DUMPLINGS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Spend 10 raw ingredients.
abilities.effect: Each friendly GOLLOP unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster can immediately use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase, but subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making the charge roll for that unit.

abilities.name: OOH, THAT LOOKS TASTY...
abilities.effect:
Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, you gain a number of raw ingredients.
The number of raw ingredients yielded by a destroyed unit is the Health characteristic of that unit multiplied by the number of starting models in that unit.

abilities.name: BONE-SLURRY SOUP
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 5 raw ingredients.
abilities.effect: Heal (D6) each friendly GOLLOP unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster.

abilities.name: FRIED LIMBS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 10 raw ingredients.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 3 to charge rolls for friendly GOLLOP units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster.

abilities.name: THE ORGAN PLATTER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 20 raw ingredients.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly Feastmaster, melee weapons used by friendly GOLLOP units have Crit (Mortal).

abilities.name: GLAND GOULASH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 10 raw ingredients.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, when making casting rolls and unbinding rolls for friendly GOLLOP units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster.

abilities.name: UNWASHED INNARDS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 5 raw ingredients.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 4 to run rolls for friendly GOLLOP units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster.

abilities.name: BLOODGRUEL
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly GOLLOP WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly GOLLOP unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
Return 1 slain model to the target.
Heal (D6) the target.

abilities.name: THE COSMOS WRITHES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly GOLLOP WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly GOLLOP unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: BONECRUNCHER
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly GOLLOP WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Gain a number of raw ingredients equal to the number of those damage points that are allocated to the target.

abilities.name: SUPPLIES DONT COME CHEAP
abilities.declare: Pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown. Each friendly unit wholly within 3" of that terrain feature is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, Heal (X) the target, where X is an amount equal to the roll.

abilities.name: NO ONE RIDES FOR FREE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY unit with up to 10 models that is wholly within 9" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: LONG-RANGE SUPPORT
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 15" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and that no friendly units are contesting. Each unit contesting that objective is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: SPECIALIST GRUNDSTOK AMMUNITION
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.declare: Pick Shieldbreaker ammunition or Thunderdrakk ammunition.
abilities.effect:
If all of the attacks made for that SHOOT ability target the same enemy unit, after that SHOOT ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that SHOOT ability. If the roll is higher than the target’s Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked:
Shieldbreaker: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.
Thunderdrakk: That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit

notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Guild Officer.

abilities.name: ADVISORY ROLE

abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly SKYFARERS units to be the targets.
abilities.effect:

abilities.name: SPREADING WARPFIRE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: If there are no flaming terrain features on the battlefield, pick a non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain feature to be the target. Otherwise, pick a non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain feature that is not flaming and that is within 12" of a flaming terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is flaming for the rest of the battle. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 6" of any flaming terrain features.

abilities.name: SMASH AND GRAB
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit that charged this turn and for which the unmodified charge roll was 8+ to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was in combat with at the start of the move.

abilities.name: TREAD CAREFULLY
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of First Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within friendly territory to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is no longer stable.

abilities.name: VIOLENT TREMOR
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the targets.
abilities.effect: The stable target objective is no longer stable. The other target objective is stable instead.

abilities.name: CLOSING THE JAWS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly BEASTCLAW HERO that is tracking the prey.
abilities.effect: Set up that HERO wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the other friendly unit that is tracking the prey wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 9" of that HERO and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: JAWS OF THE BEAST
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly BEASTCLAW HERO that is leading a regiment and that has not been deployed, then pick a non-HERO unit in that HERO’s regiment that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve tracking the prey. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: EAT ’EM ALIVE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly OGOR unit that used a FIGHT ability that targeted a unit, excluding FACTION TERRAIN, this turn to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect:
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target (if any). Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that friendly OGOR unit for the rest of the battle. If any of these effects already apply to it, you can pick a different effect to replace the current effect.
Raw and Bloody Flesh: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that unit.
Exotic Giblets: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by that unit’s combat attacks made with non-Companion weapons.
Steaming Brains: Add 2 to that unit’s Control characteristic.
Crunchy Bones: That unit’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits). If that unit’s melee weapons already have Crit (2 Hits), they have Crit (Mortal) instead.
Slick Innards: That unit can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN ability in the same turn.
Mystery Meat: Subtract 1 from the power level of enemy units while they are in combat with that unit, to a minimum of 0.
Designer’s Note: Only 1 of these effects can apply to the same unit at the same time unless specified otherwise. Also note that Steaming Brains affects the Control characteristic, not the control score.

abilities.name: BULL CHARGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit that charged this turn and has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Your opponent must move the target up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of your units and can end that move in combat.
After your opponent has done so, roll a dice for each model in the unit using this ability that is within 3" of the target. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability is a GUTBUSTERS unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
Then, the unit using this ability can make a pile-in move. If the target of this ability is still in combat with the unit using this ability, then the target of this ability must be picked as the target of the pile-in move.
Designer’s Note: Your opponent may not be able to move the models in the target unit (or may choose to leave them where they are) but the target still counts as having moved for rules purposes.

abilities.name: NAUGHTY OR NICE?
abilities.effect:
If you are the naughty player, friendly units’ melee weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) while they are contesting Da Red Gobbo.
If you are the nice player, friendly units have WARD (6+) while they are contesting Da Red Gobbo

abilities.name: CLANK, CLANK, CLANK
abilities.effect:
Roll 3D6. If Da Red Gobbo is within a number of inches of the exit point equal to the roll, he escapes, the battle ends immediately and both players lose.
Otherwise, pick a point on the battlefield within a number of inches of Da Red Gobbo equal to the roll. That point must be as near as possible to the exit point. Remove Da Red Gobbo from the battlefield and set him up again as near as possible to that point and more than 1" from all terrain features. If you are the underdog, set him up again within 6" of that point and more than 1" from all terrain features instead.

abilities.name: MAGNIFICENT MONSTROSITY
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect. If any enemy units are contesting Da Red Gobbo, you can add or subtract 1 from the roll (to a minimum of 1).
1
…Da Green Button?: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each unit’s melee weapons (friendly and enemy) for the rest of the turn.
2
…Da Blue Button?: Each player can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll or 1 random characteristic roll for a weapon’s Damage characteristic this turn.
3
…Da Yellow Button?: Each player gains 1 command point.
4
…Da Orange Button?: Each unit (friendly and enemy) on the battlefield has a Move characteristic of 3D6" for the rest of the turn.
5
…Da Purple Button?: Units (friendly and enemy) are not visible to other units outside their combat range for the rest of the turn.
6
…Da Red Button?: You must immediately use the ‘Clank, Clank, Clank’ ability as if it were the end of your turn.
7+
…Da Whirly Button?: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of Da Red Gobbo. Remove that unit from the battlefield. Then your opponent picks a point on the battlefield. Set up that enemy unit within 1" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units. Each model in that enemy unit that cannot be set up in this way is automatically slain.

abilities.name: EMBERSTONE CACHE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit contesting an objective you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target an emberstone sliver.

abilities.name: EMBERSTONE-AUGMENTED WEAPONS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn and has any emberstone slivers to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Then, if you are the underdog, remove all of the target’s emberstone slivers. Otherwise, remove all emberstone slivers from each friendly unit.

abilities.declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.

abilities.effect: The unit in this Regiment of Renown has WARD (6+).

abilities.effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll for each other friendly BIG or LITTLE unit that is in combat and within this unit’s combat range. On a 3+, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by abilities used by this unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Menhir Club is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilities.name: MENHIR CLUB

abilities.effect: Pick another visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and make a rampage roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if the target is LITTLE. On a 3+, the target’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: SUMMON PURPLE SUN OF SHYISH

abilities.name: RUSTY GRATER
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, after that ability has been resolved, Heal (D3) this unit.

abilities.name: KEY TO THE LARDER
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly OGOR INFANTRY unit on the battlefield to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

abilities.name: A CHOICE CUT
abilities.effect:
This unit cannot use RUN abilities.
Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly OGOR INFANTRY unit each phase while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

abilities.name: COLLAPSING PASS
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick each objective to be the targets. Then, pick 1 of the targets to be the focus.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. Add 1 to the roll for each unit (friendly and enemy) that is contesting it. If the target is the focus, you can add 3 to or subtract 3 from the roll. On a 8+, remove the target from the battlefield.

abilities.name: SKEWER IT AGAIN!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by a shooting attack made by the Beast-skewer Killbow in this Regiment of Renown. Then, pick any number of Man-skewer Boltboyz units in this Regiment of Renown to focus fire.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the ranged weapons used by the units you picked to focus fire but all of their attacks must target the enemy MONSTER you picked.

abilities.name: SKEWERING BOLTS

abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the Damage characteristic of this unit’s Beast-skewer Bolts is 6 if the target is a MONSTER.

abilities.name: PULLIN’ AHEAD
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in this Regiment of Renown that charged this turn and has not used any RAMPAGE abilities this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can move D6". It must end that move in combat. Then, add 1 to the target’s momentum points. After this ability has been resolved, the target cannot use any other RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: FLATTENED INTO THE MUD

abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice and add the number of momentum points this unit has to the roll. On a 5+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: UNSTOPPABLE MOMENTUM

Each time this unit has charged as a result of using a CHARGE ability, it gains 1 momentum point.
Each time it uses a RUN ability, it gains 2 momentum points. It can have a maximum of 3 momentum points at once.
Add the number of momentum points this unit has to the Damage characteristic of its Maw-grunta’s Tusks. At the end of each battle round, subtract 1 from its momentum points, to a minimum of 0.

abilities.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: PUNISHMENT FITS THE CRIME
abilities.effect: You believe the ‘Accusations of Regicide’ DELUSION (see Grand Justice Gormayne’s warscroll).

abilities.name: ELITE GUARDIANS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat with any enemy units that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, this unit has STRIKE-FIRST but ward rolls cannot be made for it.

abilities.name: ROYAL BODYGUARD
abilities.effect: While any friendly non-MONSTER FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those HEROES have WARD (5+).

warscrolls.name: Royal Decapitator
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

abilities.name: EXECUTIONER’S ENTOURAGE
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly SERFS unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

abilities.name: OFF WITH THEIR HEAD!
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Immediately after that FIGHT ability has been resolved, pick an enemy INFANTRY HERO in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

warscrolls.name: Grand Justice Gormayne
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

abilities.name: ACCUSATIONS OF REGICIDE
abilities.effect: While you believe this DELUSION, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly SERFS and KNIGHTS units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES that had any damage points allocated to them in the same turn.

abilities.name: ARREST THOSE MISCREANTS!
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has STRIKE-LAST while it is in combat with any friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES and any friendly SERFS or KNIGHTS units.

abilities.name: MAWMEAT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly ROVING MAW WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, units on or within 1" of the target are vulnerable to Mawpits. This ability has no effect on ROVING MAW units or units that have FLY.

abilities.name: RETCHER
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly ROVING MAW WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the Rend characteristic of the caster’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: DRIVEN BY STARVATION
abilities.effect: Friendly Gorger Mawpack units can use CHARGE abilities even if they used a RUN ability in the same turn unless they are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature.

abilities.name: TRAMPLING CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly ROVING MAW unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: THE REALM HUNGERS
abilities.effect: Units and MANIFESTATIONS are vulnerable to Mawpits while they are on the battlefield unless they are wholly within 1" of a terrain feature that is not a Mawpit. This ability has no effect on ROVING MAW units or units that have FLY.

abilities.name: MAWPITS OF GHUR
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.effect:
Roll 2D6 and add the number of tasty morsels you have to the roll. Apply the corresponding effect below for the rest of the battle round. Then, reset your tasty morsels to 0.
2-3 – Subdued: No effect.
4-5 – Peckish: Subtract 3 from the control scores of units that are vulnerable to Mawpits.
6-8 – Rumbling: Roll a dice for each unit that is vulnerable to Mawpits. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.
9-11 – Famished: Units that are vulnerable to Mawpits cannot use commands.
12+ – Ravenous: Roll a D3 for each unit that is vulnerable to Mawpits. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: TASTY MORSELS
abilities.effect: Each time a model is slain by a friendly Mawpit’s ‘Hungry Sinkhole’ ability, you gain 1 tasty morsel.

abilities.name: FLASKS OF CONGEALED MAW-JUICES
abilities.effect: Friendly Mawpits within this unit’s combat range have WARD (5+).

abilities.name: PRIME GUTSERVER
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.effect: If this unit is within 1" of a friendly Mawpit, gain 1 tasty morsel.

abilities.name: REDEPLOY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Each model in that unit can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

abilities.name: AT THE DOUBLE
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that RUN ability.
Do not make a run roll as part of that RUN ability. Instead, add 6" to that unit’s Move characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that RUN ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a RUN ability

abilities.name: ALL-OUT ATTACK
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made as part of that ATTACK ability. This also affects weapons that have the Companion weapon ability. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the unit using this ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: FORWARD TO VICTORY
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that CHARGE ability.
You can re-roll the charge roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a CHARGE ability

abilities.name: COUNTER-CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.

abilities.name: GUARDED HERO
abilities.effect:
If this HERO(not MONSTER or WAR MACHINES) is within the combat range of a friendly unit that is not a HERO:
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this HERO.
If this HERO is INFANTRY, they cannot be picked as the target of shooting attacks made by models more than 12" from them.

abilities.name: CHAMPION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by champions in this unit. If this unit is a BEAST, this ability affects this unit’s Companion weapons.

abilities.name: DEPLOY FACTION TERRAIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly faction terrain feature that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target faction terrain feature wholly within friendly territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: DEPLOY REGIMENT
abilities.declare: Pick a regiment from your army roster to be the target. No units in that regiment can have already been deployed.
abilities.effect: Keep using DEPLOY abilities without alternating until all units in that regiment have been deployed. You cannot set up units that are not in that regiment on the battlefield or in reserve as part of any of those Deploy abilities.

abilities.name: DEPLOY UNIT
abilities.declare: Pick a unit from your army roster that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target unit wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from enemy territory. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: ALL-OUT DEFENCE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A unit targeted by that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to save rolls for that unit until that ATTACK ability has been resolved.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: SHOOT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the unit using this ability has charged.

abilities.name: FIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat or that charged this turn to use this ability. That unit can make a pile-in move (see 15.3). Then, if that unit is in combat, you must pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: NORMAL MOVE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RUN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Make a run roll of D6. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the run roll. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RETREAT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but cannot end that move within an enemy unit’s combat range.

abilities.name: MAGICAL INTERVENTION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That friendly unit can use a SPELL, PRAYER or BANISH ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from casting rolls or chanting rolls made as part of that ability.

abilities.name: RALLY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Make 6 rally rolls of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 rally point. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:
For each rally point spent, Heal (1) that unit.
You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to that unit.
You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

abilities.name: STANDARD BEARER
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any standard bearers, add 1 to this unit’s control score.

abilities.name: FLY
abilities.effect: As this unit moves, it ignores other models, terrain features and the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end its move in combat unless specified in the ability that allowed it to move. Ignore any vertical distance moved for this unit.

abilities.name: WARD SAVE
abilities.effect: In step 1 of the damage sequence (see 18.0), make a ward roll of D6 for each damage point in this unit’s damage pool. If the roll equals or exceeds this unit’s ward value, remove that damage point from the damage pool.

abilities.name: BANISH MANIFESTATION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability, pick a MANIFESTATION within 30" of them that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the banishment roll for each additional enemy MANIFESTATION on the battlefield after the first. You cannot pick the same MANIFESTATION to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the MANIFESTATION’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: SACRED RITES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly PRIEST to use this ability, then make a chanting roll of D6. On an unmodified chanting roll of 1, remove 1 ritual point from that PRIEST instead of D3.
abilities.effect: Give a number to ritual points to the PRIEST equal to the unmodified chanting roll and do not reset the PRIEST’s ritual points to 0.

abilities.name: POWER THROUGH
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then you must pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The target must have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: MUSICIAN
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any musicians, if it uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make one additional rally roll of D6.

abilities.name: UNBIND
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A friendly WIZARD within 30" of the enemy WIZARD casting the spell.
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. This reaction cannot be used more than once per casting roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

abilities.name: COVERING FIRE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that did not use a RUN ability this turn and that is not in combat to use this ability, then pick the closest enemy unit (to that unit) that can be picked as the target of shooting attacks to be the target. You cannot pick MANIFESTATIONS or faction terrain features as the target of this ability.
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks for the unit using this ability against the target. You must subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.

abilities.name: ACTIVATE PLACE OF POWER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HERO within 3" of any Places of Power to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on that HERO. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:
Ignite Fury: Gain 2 rage dice, then increase your fury level by 2, to a maximum of 7.
Channel Wrath: If that HERO is a WIZARD or PRIEST, add 1 to casting rolls or chanting rolls for that HERO for the rest of the turn.
Dizzying Rage: For the rest of the turn, if that HERO is not a WIZARD or PRIEST, they can use the ’Unbind’ or ’Banish Manifestation’ ability as if they had WIZARD (1).

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3.
It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: MERCENARY ATTITUDES
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly non-UNIQUE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn and while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit:
You can re-roll run rolls for the target.
Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
The target cannot be targeted by shooting attacks.
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Add 10 to the target’s control score.

abilities.name: DEAD CUNNING, FOR A GARGANT
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the unit in this Regiment of Renown has STRIKE-LAST and WARD (5+). Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
A Kunnin’ Ruse: Other than the Companion ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target the unit in this Regiment of Renown have no effect.
A Nasty Surprise: Add 1 to hit rolls for the unit in this Regiment of Renown’s combat attacks and ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for its combat attacks.
Tricked Ya!: Enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown.

warscrolls.name: Kraken-eater Mega-Gargant
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout.

abilities.name: SHIPWRECKA WARCLUB
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Shipwrecka Warclub.

abilities.name: GREEDY SHOW-OFFS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly BIG or LITTLE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If this unit is contesting its loot hoard, apply the effect below. Otherwise, make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Shipwrecka Warclub is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilities.name: GET ORF ME LAND!
abilities.declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature on the battlefield to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, the target is this unit’s loot hoard. While the unit that used this ability is contesting its loot hoard, add 10 to its control score. While the unit that used this ability is not contesting its loot hoard, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its Almighty Stomp.

abilities.name: MANTLE OF ENTRAILS
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a command, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 3+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

abilities.name: TROPHY RACK
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following trophies. For the rest of the battle, melee weapons used by other friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES units have the corresponding weapon ability while they are wholly within 6" of and visible to this unit:
Squeezed Head: Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend)
Smashed City Rubble: Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)
Torn Appendages: Anti-CAVALRY (+1 Rend)

abilities.name: CARVALOX HIDE
abilities.effect: This unit has WARD (6+). It also has WARD (4+) against damage points inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.

abilities.name: HORN TOSS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model, that is in combat with this unit and that has charged this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of this unit. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: EXTREMELY OBSTINATE
abilities.effect: This unit has a Control characteristic of 15.

abilities.name: GRUMPY ALPHA
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick another visible friendly OGOR MONSTER wholly within 12" of this unit that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, roll a dice. The target can move a distance in inches up to the roll. It can end that move in combat. If it does so, the target has charged.

abilities.name: DEVASTATING COLLAPSE
abilities.effect: When the unit in this Regiment of Renown is destroyed, before removing it from play, you and your opponent must roll off. If you roll higher, inflict 3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within its combat range.

abilities.name: JUMP UP AND DOWN
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If the unit in this Regiment of Renown charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. Add 1 to each roll if the target is contesting an objective you do not control. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any of the rolls were an unmodified 1, resolve the effect of the Devastating Collapse’ ability as if the unit in this Regiment of Renown had been destroyed (it is neither destroyed nor removed from play).

abilities.name: BET YOU CAN’T...
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly Mancrusher Gargant on the battlefield to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
...Kill the Big Eads: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons while they are in combat with any enemy HEROES or MONSTERS.
...Get There Before Me!: Up to 3 of the targets can each use the Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
...Grab That!: Add 5 to each target’s control score for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: EXCITABLE FOLLOWERS
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT HERO, this unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: DETERMINED DEFENDERS
abilities.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly units while they are wholly outside enemy territory.

abilities.name: SECURE THE GATEWAY
abilities.effect: While you control the Place of Power wholly within friendly territory, friendly units’ melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are contesting an objective you control.

abilities.name: SUMMON HORRORGHAST
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Horrorghast wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SOULSCREAM BRIDGE
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulscream Bridge on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Soulscream Bridge wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulscream Bridge has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: SUMMON LAUCHON THE SOULSEEKER
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Lauchon the Soulseeker on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SHARDS OF VALAGHARR
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Shards of Valagharr endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
